integrity: The proof separates the published non-equivariant finite-subset-space input from the new equivariant calculation. The parity sign is derived from the twist degree on a smash product, and a standalone replay checks the resulting group action and character formulas.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the based third finite-subset space under permutations of equally oriented sphere summands. It does not describe arbitrary self-homotopy-equivalence actions or assert an equivariant homotopy splitting. Literature search cannot exclude every unindexed equivalent symmetric-product representation calculation.
title: Parity controls the symmetric-group homology of based third finite-subset spaces of sphere bouquets
